comparison.objective: Insert a flex cable into a ZIF connector while holding it and close the latch; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual thin-cable alignment, insertion, stabilization, and latch closure versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, lateral-load control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Cable fully inserted, latch shut, and both hands released; candidate requires four fractures and all fragments contained without moving or damaging inserts.
comparison.reason: This is dexterously similar in bimanual stabilization, but the central mechanism and tested outcome are insertion/latching rather than controlled fracture and debris recovery.
